issues.title: Inconsistent Button Styling
issues.description: The primary action buttons have inconsistent styling. Some use rounded corners while others have sharp corners.

issues.title: Poor Text Contrast
issues.description: The light gray text on white background in the sidebar has insufficient contrast, making it difficult to read.

recommendations: Standardize button styling across the interface for better visual consistency.
Increase text contrast in the sidebar to meet WCAG AA accessibility standards.
Consider adding more spacing between UI elements to improve readability.
